description: This source file appears to be a shell script used for running HTTP status tests on the gitweb CGI interface. It sets environment variables, sources other scripts, runs Perl modules to check prerequisites, and executes a series of automated tests to verify HTTP responses, snapshot functionality, modification times, load handling, and argument validation.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Checks for Perl modules HTTP::Date and Time::ParseDate to ensure they are available for date parsing tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines individual test cases expecting success with specific conditions and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Introduces a small delay to ensure distinct timestamps for commit actions.

methods.name: test_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information, such as contents of output or headers files.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function to execute the gitweb CGI script with specified parameters and capture the output for verification.
